raw_segments.text: She pointed to a wide arch corresponding to the window and hung like it with a Tyrian-dyed curtain, now looped up.
Mounting to it by two broad steps and looking through,
I thought I caught a glimpse of a fairy place so bright to my novices appeared the view beyond.
Yet it was merely a very pretty drawing room and within it a boudoir, both spread with white carpets on which seemed laid
both sealed with snowy moldings of white grapes and vine leaves beneath which glowed in rich contrast crimson couches and ottomans.
While the ornaments on the pale perian mantlepiece were of sparkling bohemian glass,
ruby red and between the windows large mirrors repeated the general blending of snow and fire.
